say:1:1230158001:1.text: Keep it down! You don't want anyone to hear this!
say:1:1230158001:1.source_cn: 您小点声！可别让别人听到了！

say:2:1230158002:1.text: Carmine Whispers are in charge now, and they are at odds with a group calling themselves Water Wights. I don't like them because they never buy my papers.
say:2:1230158002:1.source_cn: 现在管事的是血薇帮，有一伙人和他们打来打去，叫水鬼帮，...

say:3:1230158003:1.text: By the way, I heard they've allied with the Dead Tide Fleet and become its affiliates...
say:3:1230158003:1.source_cn: 对了，我听说他们投靠了死潮舰队，成了死潮舰队的附属……

say:4:1230158004:1.text: Remember to steer clear of anyone dressed in the Water Wight uniform! They'll eat you alive—that's what I heard!
say:4:1230158004:1.source_cn: 您要是看到穿着水鬼帮衣服的人，千万别接近！他们会把您生...
